task: In hooks/post_tool_use.py, the heartbeat write falls back to a literal 'unknown' session id whenever payload.get('session_id') is empty/missing, and then writes that heartbeat to disk. That file (~/.heater/heartbeat/unknown.json) is never cleaned up and never updates again unless another sessionless hook call happens, so bin/bearings.py permanently reports it as a dead/quiet heartbeat with no matching dispatch — a standing false alarm. Fix so a missing session_id does not produce a permanent stale heartbeat entry: e.g. skip writing the heartbeat file entirely when session_id is absent, rather than falling back to a fixed 'unknown' name. Update or add a test pinning the new behavior (see tests around hooks/post_tool_use.py and tools/bearings.py heartbeat handling). Then delete the existing stale ~/.heater/heartbeat/unknown.json file left over from this bug.
done_when: bin/gate.sh passes, a test pins the no-heartbeat-on-missing-session-id behavior, and the stale unknown.json is gone
